primary_insight: After subtracting undersampling, TAC, NCR/IM, FAC, CIC and JAC, the remaining unknown is Interscale-Operator Absence: two empirically occupied scales of one named process have no owner for the transfer function that would take a state at scale A and emit a unique pre-registered prediction at scale B. Highest remaining surface is the wood-wide web (hypha 10 µm → forest 10³ m), where four ordinary alternative paths (soil-water diffusion, root contact, other microbes, eavesdrop-byproduct) remain unexcluded in the field (Karst 2023; Oxford 2025). Not a claim that trees communicate.
capability_gap_identified: No existing tool tracks, against a local archive of already-claimed structural classes, whether two empirically occupied scales of one named process have a pre-registered transfer function whose ordinary alternative transports have been excluded in the field.
